metadata.oracle_evidence: solution/trajectory.npz replays the validated Sharpa Wave authoring trajectory in both modes (1,529 rows; the episode ends at success after 1,379 controls, with the source's 1.66 mm socket throat). Two fresh-process replays give identical state hashes; Harbor 0.23 oracle trials score 1 in privileged and standard mode, nop trials 0.

notes.layout: Both hands hang from the same six-axis wrist stage, with the same wrist joints, ranges, gains and start targets; the wrist targets are the world position (m) and serial XYZ angles (rad) of the hand mount.
